method: Exact equality of verified source-reported security identifier, exact trimmed security-class label, quantity type and put/call at the same reporting date. No issuer-name matching.

coverage.allSourceScopedInstrumentIdsHashMeaning: SHA-256 of the sorted opaque source-scoped public IDs separated by newlines; contains no proprietary identifier material.

semantics.unlistedInstruments: Remain source-scoped singletons. Absence of a match is not evidence of different instruments or absence of holdings.
semantics.classDifferences: Different class labels remain unmatched even if the private identifier matches; no ADR/common/preferred/other-class consolidation.
semantics.rowPolicy: Equivalence links instruments only. Retain every original position row and manager reference; do not deduplicate holdings or multiply rows by links.
semantics.ownershipLabel: Disclosed investment-discretion positions among the three loaded filers, not all investors or an ownership register.
semantics.identifierPolicy: Only opaque existing source-scoped IDs are emitted. No raw proprietary identifier, identifier hash, ticker mapping or proprietary-identifier crosswalk is included.

admission.scope: Factual equivalence and data-minimization approval for the current bounded SEC-sourced historical research/navigation view among the three admitted filers. No claim of blanket proprietary-identifier licensing clearance.
constraints: Label links as matching reported instruments and reporting filers at 2026-06-30, not all investors, company-level ownership, legal ownership or current positions.
Keep different security classes and depositary receipts distinct; do not broaden the exact-match rule to fuzzy names or issuer consolidation.
Retain all original position rows, source lineage and reporting-manager references. An equivalence link must never deduplicate source holdings or multiply values.
Do not sum across filers into a purported unique economic exposure or ownership percentage. Existing combination-report, overlap and amendment qualifications continue to apply.
Absence of an equivalence group is unknown/unmatched, not proof of no holding or a different issuer.
Publish only opaque source-scoped memberships; do not publish raw proprietary identifiers, hashes derived from those identifiers, source XML or a reusable identifier-value lookup.
This review does not establish a blanket license for commercial identifier-derived data redistribution or third-party commercial feeds. Those uses require a separate rights review.

rightsReview.source: Independent extraction of facts from SEC-hosted public filing tables; no CGS commercial database or authorized-vendor dataset used.
rightsReview.note: SEC website dissemination policy permits copying its public information without SEC permission. CGS describes distinct licensing terms for its commercial data and recognizes independently collected public-source noncommercial use when the source permits it. Approval here is bounded factual research/navigation admission, not a legal opinion or transferable commercial redistribution license.
